description: This file defines the GatewayDiscoveryModel class responsible for discovering and managing gateways on local and wide-area networks using zeroconf/mDNS and other discovery methods. It includes data structures for representing local identities and gateways, methods for starting/stopping discovery, handling network results, resolving services, and filtering local gateways.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel
classes.description: Main class responsible for discovering gateways via network browsing and fallback mechanisms, managing internal state, and providing gateway data to the application.

classes.name: ResolvedGatewayService
classes.description: Holds resolved network service details such as TXT records, host, and port information.

classes.name: GatewayServiceResolver
classes.description: Handles resolution of network services via NetService, including start, cancel, and delegate methods for resolving address and TXT records.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins browsing for gateways over specified domains.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all ongoing discovery tasks and clears internal state.

methods.name: refreshRemoteFallbackNow
methods.description: Triggers immediate refresh of fallback gateways via wide area and Tailscale Serve methods.

methods.name: ensureServiceResolution
methods.description: Initiates resolution of a specific service if not already resolved or in progress.

methods.name: parseGatewayTXT
methods.description: Parses a dictionary of strings into structured gateway TXT info.

methods.name: buildSSHTarget
methods.description: Constructs an SSH target string from user, host, and port.
